answer_4.quote: Members of the research team rated a sample of 500 knowledge tuples, with each sample evaluated by three members.
answer_4.guideline: We use a 4-point Likert scale as our scoring metric , reflecting how reasonable each knowledge tuple is and ranging from Invalid (score 4) to Always/Often (score 1), with a lower score indicating higher quality.
